520	# [#1805/SPEC-12]: intake must emit stage.start on a fresh run (not skipped by
521	# rehydration, which only applies on resume). This pins the new-run side of the
522	# ADR-050 §6 boundary: the prior-work reuse invariant governs new runs; a resume
523	# (governed by ADR-006) is the only path that may skip complete stages.
524	_s12_intake_starts=0
525	if [[ -f "$S12_EVENTS_JSONL" ]]; then
526	    _s12_intake_starts="$(jq -r 'select(.type=="stage.start") | .data.stage // empty' \
527	        "$S12_EVENTS_JSONL" 2>/dev/null | grep -c '^intake$' 2>/dev/null || echo 0)"
528	fi
529	assert_eq "[#1805/SPEC-12] fresh run dispatches intake (not skipped; ADR-050 §6 new-run side)" \
530	    "1" "$_s12_intake_starts"
531	
532	# [#1805/SPEC-12]: the cycled sub-stage must dispatch (cycle executed; no stage skipped).
533	# Before fix: ZBUILD_CYCLES_ENABLED=0 suppresses the cycle → cycled_starts=0 → assert_gt fails.
534	# After fix: cycles enabled, cycled sub-stage runs for the 1 configured iteration → PASSES.
535	_s12_cycled_starts=0
536	if [[ -f "$S12_EVENTS_JSONL" ]]; then
537	    _s12_cycled_starts="$(jq -r 'select(.type=="stage.start") | .data.stage // empty' \
538	        "$S12_EVENTS_JSONL" 2>/dev/null | grep -c '^cycled$' 2>/dev/null || echo 0)"
539	fi
540	assert_gt "[#1805/SPEC-12] fresh run dispatches cycled sub-stage (cycle ran; no stage skipped)" \
541	    "$_s12_cycled_starts" "0"
542	
543	# [#1805/SPEC-12]: the cycle fixture used for this fresh-run sub-case contains type: cycle,
544	# establishing that the fixture IS a cyclic pipeline (satisfying the "same cycle fixture" clause).
545	_s12_fixt_content="$(cat "$REPO_ROOT/tests/fixtures/templates/artifact-snapshot-coverage.yaml")"
546	assert_contains "[#1805/SPEC-12] cycle fixture used in SPEC-12 fresh-run sub-case has type: cycle" \
547	    "$_s12_fixt_content" "type: cycle"
548	
549	# ── SPEC-13: test uses a fixture containing a cyclic stage ────────────────────
550	print_test_section "resume-rehydrate test uses a fixture containing a cyclic stage"
551	
552	# : the fixture must contain type: cycle (satisfies "containing a cyclic stage").
553	# Already read into _s12_fixt_content above from artifact-snapshot-coverage.yaml.
554	assert_contains "resume-rehydrate fixture contains type: cycle" \
555	    "$_s12_fixt_content" "type: cycle"
556	
557	# : a pipeline using that cyclic fixture was actually run in this test.
558	# _s12_cycled_starts was computed in the SPEC-12 section from the S12 pipeline run.
559	# Before fix: ZBUILD_CYCLES_ENABLED=0 → cycled never dispatches → 0 → assert_gt fails.
560	# After fix (cycles enabled, max_iter=1): cycled dispatches → assert_gt passes.
561	assert_gt "resume-rehydrate: pipeline with cyclic fixture was actually run (cycled dispatched)" \
562	    "$_s12_cycled_starts" "0"

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Tests: resume rehydrates completed-stage artifacts from the git state branch
# before the dispatch loop. (issue #1805, ADR-006 §3.5)
#
# SPEC-1 [code]: on resume, runner calls _artifact_persist_restore +
#   _artifact_persist_put_back and places completed-stage artifacts into
#   ZBUILD_ARTIFACT_DIR before the dispatch loop; the complete stage emits
#   no stage.start event.
#
# SPEC-2 [code]: a complete stage whose primary artifact is absent from both
#   disk and the git state branch causes the resume to exit 1 before any
#   stage.start event is emitted.
#
# SPEC-5 [no-code]: ADR-006-resume-contract.md amended with step 3.5:
#   before the dispatch loop the runner restores completed-stage artifacts from
#   the git state branch; a still-absent artifact causes exit 1; enforcing
#   test names added inline.
#
# SPEC-6 [no-code]: ADR-050-prior-work-reuse-contract.md §6 amended with
#   boundary note: the invariant applies to new runs; a resume continues the
#   same run and is governed by ADR-006.
set -euo pipefail

SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
REPO_ROOT="$(cd "$SCRIPT_DIR/../.." && pwd)"
RUNNER="$REPO_ROOT/core/pipeline/runner.sh"
ZBUILD_CLI="$REPO_ROOT/scripts/zbuild"
ADR_006="$REPO_ROOT/docs/adr/ADR-006-resume-contract.md"
ADR_050="$REPO_ROOT/docs/adr/ADR-050-prior-work-reuse-contract.md"

# shellcheck source=../../scripts/lib/helpers.sh
source "$REPO_ROOT/scripts/lib/helpers.sh"
# shellcheck source=../../scripts/lib/test-helpers.sh
source "$REPO_ROOT/scripts/lib/test-helpers.sh"
# shellcheck source=../../core/state/artifact-persist.sh
source "$REPO_ROOT/core/state/artifact-persist.sh"

print_test_header "resume-rehydrate — artifact restore on resume (#1805)"
setup_test_env "resume-rehydrate-1805"
export ZBUILD_CONTRACT_VALIDATOR=warn

_ZB_ID="$(zb_test_issue)"

# ── Shared infrastructure ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────

# Create a git repo that the runner will use (CWD of the subprocess).
# The state branch is written here; the runner also reads from here.
WORK_REPO="$(setup_git_temp_repo resume-rehydrate-work)"
git -C "$WORK_REPO" config user.email t@e.st
git -C "$WORK_REPO" config user.name t

install_template_overlay "$WORK_REPO" runner-state-dir-minimal

# Create mock plugins (intake + build, each declaring a primary artifact).
mock_plugin_factory "intake" "agent" 0 >/dev/null
mock_plugin_factory "build"  "agent" 0 >/dev/null
PLUGINS_ROOT="$TEST_TEMP_DIR/plugins"

# ── SPEC-1: resume rehydrates artifacts from git state branch ─────────────────
print_test_section "[#1805/SPEC-1] resume restores completed-stage artifact into ZBUILD_ARTIFACT_DIR"

S1_STATE_DIR="$TEST_TEMP_DIR/s1-state"
S1_EVENTS_DIR="$TEST_TEMP_DIR/s1-events"
S1_EVENTS_JSONL="$S1_EVENTS_DIR/events.jsonl"
S1_STATE_FILE="$S1_STATE_DIR/pipeline-state.json"
mkdir -p "$S1_STATE_DIR/artifacts" "$S1_EVENTS_DIR"

# Write the intake primary artifact so the snapshot captures it.
printf '{"result_contract":3,"outcome":"pass","reason":"prior-run intake"}' \
    > "$S1_STATE_DIR/artifacts/intake-result.json"

# Snapshot the artifact onto the state branch in WORK_REPO.
_s1_snap_rc=0
( export ZBUILD_STATE_DIR="$S1_STATE_DIR"
  cd "$WORK_REPO" && _artifact_persist_snapshot "$S1_STATE_DIR" "$_ZB_ID" ) \
    >"$TEST_TEMP_DIR/s1-snap.log" 2>&1 || _s1_snap_rc=$?
if [[ "$_s1_snap_rc" -ne 0 ]]; then
    assert_fail "[#1805/SPEC-1] setup: snapshot to state branch failed" \
        "rc=$_s1_snap_rc; $(cat "$TEST_TEMP_DIR/s1-snap.log" 2>/dev/null | tail -5)"
else
    assert_pass "[#1805/SPEC-1] setup: state branch populated with intake-result.json"
fi

# Remove the artifact from disk to simulate the "artifacts not on disk" scenario.
rm -f "$S1_STATE_DIR/artifacts/intake-result.json"

# Write state file: intake=complete, build=pending.
jq -n \
    --arg run_id "s1-resume-1805" \
    --arg now "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" \
    --argjson issue "$_ZB_ID" \
    '{
        schema_version: 1,
        run_id: $run_id,
        issue: $issue,
        stage_statuses: {intake: "complete", build: "pending"},
        current_iteration: 0,
        self_heal_count: {},
        scope_manifest_hash: "",
        cost_ledger_pointer: 0,
        claim_lease_id: "",
        plugin_state: {},
        status: "in_progress",
        updated_at: $now
    }' > "$S1_STATE_FILE"

# Run runner --resume. CWD=WORK_REPO so _artifact_persist_restore finds the
# state branch. Capture rc; do not abort on failure.
set +e
( cd "$WORK_REPO" && env \
    ZBUILD_CYCLES_ENABLED=0 \
    ZBUILD_PLUGINS_ROOT="$PLUGINS_ROOT" \
    ZBUILD_STATE_DIR="$S1_STATE_DIR" \
    ZBUILD_STATE_FILE="$S1_STATE_FILE" \
    ZBUILD_EVENTS_DIR="$S1_EVENTS_DIR" \
    ZBUILD_EVENTS_JSONL="$S1_EVENTS_JSONL" \
    ZBUILD_EVENT_SCHEMA="$REPO_ROOT/config/event-schema.json" \
    ZBUILD_CONTRACT_VALIDATOR=warn \
    ZBUILD_VISION_GATE=off \
    PATH="$PATH" HOME="$HOME" \
    bash "$RUNNER" --template runner-state-dir-minimal --resume --issue "$_ZB_ID" ) \
    >"$TEST_TEMP_DIR/s1-stdout.txt" 2>"$TEST_TEMP_DIR/s1-stderr.txt"
_s1_rc=$?
set -e

# [#1805/SPEC-1]: artifact must be present in ZBUILD_ARTIFACT_DIR after resume.
# Before the change: no rehydration → file absent → FAILS.
# After the change: rehydration copies artifact from state branch → PASSES.
assert_file_exists "[#1805/SPEC-1] intake-result.json rehydrated into ZBUILD_ARTIFACT_DIR" \
    "$S1_STATE_DIR/artifacts/intake-result.json"

# [#1805/SPEC-1]: intake must NOT have a stage.start event (it was complete and skipped).
_s1_intake_starts=0
if [[ -f "$S1_EVENTS_JSONL" ]]; then
    _s1_intake_starts="$(grep -c '"type":"stage.start"' "$S1_EVENTS_JSONL" \
        | xargs | grep -c '^[1-9]' 2>/dev/null || true)"
    # More precise: count stage.start events whose data.stage == "intake"
    _s1_intake_starts="$(jq -r 'select(.type=="stage.start") | .data.stage // empty' \
        "$S1_EVENTS_JSONL" 2>/dev/null | grep -c '^intake$' 2>/dev/null || echo 0)"
fi
assert_eq "[#1805/SPEC-1] intake emits no stage.start (complete stage skipped)" \
    "0" "$_s1_intake_starts"

# ── SPEC-1 path 2: auto-resume on status=interrupted ─────────────────────────
# [#1805/SPEC-1] all entry paths: path 2 — auto-resume when status=interrupted.
# No --resume flag; runner detects interrupted status and auto-resumes.
print_test_section "[#1805/SPEC-1] path 2: auto-resume (status=interrupted) restores artifacts"

S1P2_ID="$(zb_test_issue)"
S1P2_STATE_DIR="$TEST_TEMP_DIR/s1p2-state"
S1P2_EVENTS_DIR="$TEST_TEMP_DIR/s1p2-events"
S1P2_EVENTS_JSONL="$S1P2_EVENTS_DIR/events.jsonl"
S1P2_STATE_FILE="$S1P2_STATE_DIR/pipeline-state.json"
mkdir -p "$S1P2_STATE_DIR/artifacts" "$S1P2_EVENTS_DIR"
touch "$S1P2_EVENTS_JSONL"

S1P2_WORK_REPO="$(setup_git_temp_repo resume-reh-s1p2)"
install_template_overlay "$S1P2_WORK_REPO" runner-state-dir-minimal

printf '{"result_contract":3,"outcome":"pass","reason":"prior-run intake"}' \
    > "$S1P2_STATE_DIR/artifacts/intake-result.json"

_s1p2_snap_rc=0
( export ZBUILD_STATE_DIR="$S1P2_STATE_DIR"
  cd "$S1P2_WORK_REPO" && _artifact_persist_snapshot "$S1P2_STATE_DIR" "$S1P2_ID" ) \
    >"$TEST_TEMP_DIR/s1p2-snap.log" 2>&1 || _s1p2_snap_rc=$?
if [[ "$_s1p2_snap_rc" -ne 0 ]]; then
    assert_fail "setup s1p2: snapshot failed (rc=$_s1p2_snap_rc)" \
        "$(cat "$TEST_TEMP_DIR/s1p2-snap.log" 2>/dev/null | tail -5)"
fi
rm -f "$S1P2_STATE_DIR/artifacts/intake-result.json"

jq -n \
    --arg run_id "s1p2-reh-1805" \
    --arg now "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" \
    --argjson issue "$S1P2_ID" \
    '{
        schema_version: 1, run_id: $run_id, issue: $issue,
        stage_statuses: {intake: "complete", build: "pending"},
        current_iteration: 0, self_heal_count: {}, scope_manifest_hash: "",
        cost_ledger_pointer: 0, claim_lease_id: "", plugin_state: {},
        status: "interrupted", updated_at: $now
    }' > "$S1P2_STATE_FILE"

set +e
( cd "$S1P2_WORK_REPO" && env \
    ZBUILD_CYCLES_ENABLED=0 \
    ZBUILD_PLUGINS_ROOT="$PLUGINS_ROOT" \
    ZBUILD_STATE_DIR="$S1P2_STATE_DIR" \
    ZBUILD_STATE_FILE="$S1P2_STATE_FILE" \
    ZBUILD_EVENTS_DIR="$S1P2_EVENTS_DIR" \
    ZBUILD_EVENTS_JSONL="$S1P2_EVENTS_JSONL" \
    ZBUILD_EVENT_SCHEMA="$REPO_ROOT/config/event-schema.json" \
    ZBUILD_CONTRACT_VALIDATOR=warn \
    ZBUILD_VISION_GATE=off \
    PATH="$PATH" HOME="$HOME" \
    bash "$RUNNER" --template runner-state-dir-minimal --issue "$S1P2_ID" ) \
    >"$TEST_TEMP_DIR/s1p2-stdout.txt" 2>"$TEST_TEMP_DIR/s1p2-stderr.txt"
set -e

# [#1805/SPEC-1] path 2 artifact restored.
# Before change: no rehydration → absent → FAILS. After change: PASSES.
assert_file_exists \
    "[#1805/SPEC-1] path 2 (auto-resume/interrupted): intake-result.json restored" \
    "$S1P2_STATE_DIR/artifacts/intake-result.json"

# [#1805/SPEC-1] path 2: content must match what was snapshotted to the git state branch.
# Proves the artifact was placed into ZBUILD_ARTIFACT_DIR FROM the git state branch, not
# reconstructed from another source. Before fix: file absent → cat empty → FAILS. After: PASSES.
_s1p2_artifact_content="$(cat "$S1P2_STATE_DIR/artifacts/intake-result.json" 2>/dev/null || true)"
assert_contains \
    "[#1805/SPEC-1] path 2 (auto-resume): artifact content placed into ZBUILD_ARTIFACT_DIR from git state branch" \
    "$_s1p2_artifact_content" "prior-run intake"

# [#1805/SPEC-1] path 2: build must have dispatched (proving pipeline ran and events written).
# Before fix: path-2 auto-resume doesn't exist → runner exits without events → build_starts=0 → FAILS.
# After fix: runner auto-resumes, rehydrates, skips intake, dispatches build → build_starts=1 → PASSES.
_s1p2_build_starts="$(jq -r 'select(.type=="stage.start") | .data.stage // empty' \
    "$S1P2_EVENTS_JSONL" 2>/dev/null | grep -c '^build$' || echo 0)"
assert_eq "[#1805/SPEC-1] path 2 (auto-resume): build dispatched (pipeline ran via path-2 resume)" \
    "1" "$_s1p2_build_starts"

# [#1805/SPEC-1] path 2: intake must NOT have a stage.start event.
_s1p2_intake_starts="$(jq -r 'select(.type=="stage.start") | .data.stage // empty' \
    "$S1P2_EVENTS_JSONL" 2>/dev/null | grep -c '^intake$' || echo 0)"
assert_eq "[#1805/SPEC-1] path 2 (auto-resume): intake emits no stage.start (skipped)" \
    "0" "$_s1p2_intake_starts"

# ── SPEC-1 path 3: zbuild pipeline resume --run-id ───────────────────────────
# [#1805/SPEC-1] all entry paths: path 3 — zbuild pipeline resume --run-id.
print_test_section "[#1805/SPEC-1] path 3: zbuild pipeline resume --run-id restores artifacts"

S1P3_ID="$(zb_test_issue)"
S1P3_RUN_ID="s1p3-reh-1805"
S1P3_STATE_DIR="$TEST_TEMP_DIR/s1p3-state"
S1P3_EVENTS_DIR="$TEST_TEMP_DIR/s1p3-events"
S1P3_EVENTS_JSONL="$S1P3_EVENTS_DIR/events.jsonl"
S1P3_STATE_FILE="$S1P3_STATE_DIR/pipeline-state.json"
mkdir -p "$S1P3_STATE_DIR/artifacts" "$S1P3_EVENTS_DIR"
touch "$S1P3_EVENTS_JSONL"

S1P3_WORK_REPO="$(setup_git_temp_repo resume-reh-s1p3)"
install_template_overlay "$S1P3_WORK_REPO" runner-state-dir-minimal

printf '{"result_contract":3,"outcome":"pass","reason":"prior-run intake"}' \
    > "$S1P3_STATE_DIR/artifacts/intake-result.json"

_s1p3_snap_rc=0
( export ZBUILD_STATE_DIR="$S1P3_STATE_DIR"
  cd "$S1P3_WORK_REPO" && _artifact_persist_snapshot "$S1P3_STATE_DIR" "$S1P3_ID" ) \
    >"$TEST_TEMP_DIR/s1p3-snap.log" 2>&1 || _s1p3_snap_rc=$?
if [[ "$_s1p3_snap_rc" -ne 0 ]]; then
    assert_fail "setup s1p3: snapshot failed (rc=$_s1p3_snap_rc)" \
        "$(cat "$TEST_TEMP_DIR/s1p3-snap.log" 2>/dev/null | tail -5)"
fi
rm -f "$S1P3_STATE_DIR/artifacts/intake-result.json"

jq -n \
    --arg run_id "$S1P3_RUN_ID" \
    --arg now "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" \
    --argjson issue "$S1P3_ID" \
    '{
        schema_version: 1, run_id: $run_id, issue: $issue,
        stage_statuses: {intake: "complete", build: "pending"},
        current_iteration: 0, self_heal_count: {}, scope_manifest_hash: "",
        cost_ledger_pointer: 0, claim_lease_id: "", plugin_state: {},
        status: "interrupted", updated_at: $now
    }' > "$S1P3_STATE_FILE"

set +e
( cd "$S1P3_WORK_REPO" && env \
    ZBUILD_CYCLES_ENABLED=0 \
    ZBUILD_PLUGINS_ROOT="$PLUGINS_ROOT" \
    ZBUILD_STATE_DIR="$S1P3_STATE_DIR" \
    ZBUILD_EVENTS_DIR="$S1P3_EVENTS_DIR" \
    ZBUILD_EVENTS_JSONL="$S1P3_EVENTS_JSONL" \
    ZBUILD_EVENT_SCHEMA="$REPO_ROOT/config/event-schema.json" \
    ZBUILD_CONTRACT_VALIDATOR=warn \
    ZBUILD_VISION_GATE=off \
    PATH="$PATH" HOME="$HOME" \
    bash "$ZBUILD_CLI" pipeline resume \
        --run-id "$S1P3_RUN_ID" \
        --template runner-state-dir-minimal ) \
    >"$TEST_TEMP_DIR/s1p3-stdout.txt" 2>"$TEST_TEMP_DIR/s1p3-stderr.txt"
set -e

# [#1805/SPEC-1] path 3 artifact restored.
# Before change: zbuild resume path has no rehydration → absent → FAILS. After change: PASSES.
assert_file_exists \
    "[#1805/SPEC-1] path 3 (zbuild pipeline resume): intake-result.json restored" \
    "$S1P3_STATE_DIR/artifacts/intake-result.json"

# [#1805/SPEC-1] path 3: content must match what was snapshotted to the git state branch.
# Proves the artifact was placed into ZBUILD_ARTIFACT_DIR FROM the git state branch, not
# reconstructed from another source. Before fix: file absent → cat empty → FAILS. After: PASSES.
_s1p3_artifact_content="$(cat "$S1P3_STATE_DIR/artifacts/intake-result.json" 2>/dev/null || true)"
assert_contains \
    "[#1805/SPEC-1] path 3 (zbuild pipeline resume): artifact content placed into ZBUILD_ARTIFACT_DIR from git state branch" \
    "$_s1p3_artifact_content" "prior-run intake"

# [#1805/SPEC-1] path 3: build must have dispatched (proving pipeline ran via zbuild pipeline resume).
# Before fix: zbuild pipeline resume path has no rehydration / may not exist → no events → FAILS.
# After fix: zbuild calls runner --resume → rehydrates → dispatches build → PASSES.
_s1p3_build_starts="$(jq -r 'select(.type=="stage.start") | .data.stage // empty' \
    "$S1P3_EVENTS_JSONL" 2>/dev/null | grep -c '^build$' || echo 0)"
assert_eq "[#1805/SPEC-1] path 3 (zbuild pipeline resume): build dispatched (pipeline ran via path-3)" \
    "1" "$_s1p3_build_starts"

# [#1805/SPEC-1] path 3: intake must NOT have a stage.start event.
_s1p3_intake_starts="$(jq -r 'select(.type=="stage.start") | .data.stage // empty' \
    "$S1P3_EVENTS_JSONL" 2>/dev/null | grep -c '^intake$' || echo 0)"
assert_eq "[#1805/SPEC-1] path 3 (zbuild pipeline resume): intake emits no stage.start (skipped)" \
    "0" "$_s1p3_intake_starts"

# ── SPEC-2: missing artifact causes resume to exit 1 ─────────────────────────
print_test_section "[#1805/SPEC-2] missing artifact causes resume exit 1 before any stage.start"

S2_STATE_DIR="$TEST_TEMP_DIR/s2-state"
S2_EVENTS_DIR="$TEST_TEMP_DIR/s2-events"
S2_EVENTS_JSONL="$S2_EVENTS_DIR/events.jsonl"
S2_STATE_FILE="$S2_STATE_DIR/pipeline-state.json"
mkdir -p "$S2_STATE_DIR/artifacts" "$S2_EVENTS_DIR"

# Use a fresh WORK_REPO2 for SPEC-2 so SPEC-1's state branch is not present.
# A new issue identity guarantees no state branch exists.
_S2_ID="$(zb_test_issue)"
WORK_REPO2="$(setup_git_temp_repo resume-rehydrate-work2)"
git -C "$WORK_REPO2" config user.email t@e.st
git -C "$WORK_REPO2" config user.name t
install_template_overlay "$WORK_REPO2" runner-state-dir-minimal

# State: intake=complete but NO artifact on disk and NO state branch.
jq -n \
    --arg run_id "s2-resume-1805" \
    --arg now "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" \
    --argjson issue "$_S2_ID" \
    '{
        schema_version: 1,
        run_id: $run_id,
        issue: $issue,
        stage_statuses: {intake: "complete", build: "pending"},
        current_iteration: 0,
        self_heal_count: {},
        scope_manifest_hash: "",
        cost_ledger_pointer: 0,
        claim_lease_id: "",
        plugin_state: {},
        status: "in_progress",
        updated_at: $now
    }' > "$S2_STATE_FILE"

set +e
( cd "$WORK_REPO2" && env \
    ZBUILD_CYCLES_ENABLED=0 \
    ZBUILD_PLUGINS_ROOT="$PLUGINS_ROOT" \
    ZBUILD_STATE_DIR="$S2_STATE_DIR" \
    ZBUILD_STATE_FILE="$S2_STATE_FILE" \
    ZBUILD_EVENTS_DIR="$S2_EVENTS_DIR" \
    ZBUILD_EVENTS_JSONL="$S2_EVENTS_JSONL" \
    ZBUILD_EVENT_SCHEMA="$REPO_ROOT/config/event-schema.json" \
    ZBUILD_CONTRACT_VALIDATOR=warn \
    ZBUILD_VISION_GATE=off \
    PATH="$PATH" HOME="$HOME" \
    bash "$RUNNER" --template runner-state-dir-minimal --resume --issue "$_S2_ID" ) \
    >"$TEST_TEMP_DIR/s2-stdout.txt" 2>"$TEST_TEMP_DIR/s2-stderr.txt"
_s2_rc=$?
set -e

# [#1805/SPEC-2]: runner must exit 1 when artifact absent from disk AND state branch.
# Before the change: runner warns about stale artifact and continues → exits 0 → FAILS.
# After the change: runner exits 1 after failing to restore the artifact → PASSES.
assert_eq "[#1805/SPEC-2] resume exits 1 when primary artifact cannot be restored" \
    "1" "$_s2_rc"

# [#1805/SPEC-2]: no stage.start event must be emitted before the exit.
# (exit 1 happens before the dispatch loop reaches any stage)
_s2_any_starts=0
if [[ -f "$S2_EVENTS_JSONL" ]]; then
    _s2_any_starts="$(jq -r 'select(.type=="stage.start") | .type' \
        "$S2_EVENTS_JSONL" 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d ' ')"
fi
assert_eq "[#1805/SPEC-2] no stage.start emitted before exit 1" \
    "0" "$_s2_any_starts"

# ── SPEC-5: ADR-006 amended with artifact-restore step 3.5 ───────────────────
print_test_section "[#1805/SPEC-5] ADR-006 amended: step 3.5 restores artifacts before dispatch loop"

# [#1805/SPEC-5]: ADR-006 must contain the amendment text describing artifact
# restoration in the resume sequence and exit 1 for an absent artifact.
# This passes after the doc change; it need not fail before.
_adr006="$(cat "$ADR_006" 2>/dev/null || true)"

assert_contains "[#1805/SPEC-5] ADR-006 step 3.6 added (step number present)" \
    "$_adr006" "3.6"

assert_contains "[#1805/SPEC-5] ADR-006 step 3.6 names _runner_resume_rehydrate" \
    "$_adr006" "_runner_resume_rehydrate"

assert_contains "[#1805/SPEC-5] ADR-006 step 3.6 names resume-rehydrate-test.sh as enforcing test" \
    "$_adr006" "resume-rehydrate-test.sh"

# [#1805/SPEC-5]: ADR-006 must document that a still-absent artifact causes exit 1.
# Before the doc change: the clause is absent → FAILS. After change: PASSES.
assert_contains "[#1805/SPEC-5] ADR-006 step 3.6 documents still-absent artifact causes exit 1" \
    "$_adr006" "exit 1"

# [#1805/SPEC-5]: ADR-006 step 3.6 must say restoration happens "before the dispatch loop".
# Before the doc change: phrase absent → FAILS. After change: PASSES.
assert_contains "[#1805/SPEC-5] ADR-006 step 3.6 documents restore happens before the dispatch loop" \
    "$_adr006" "before the dispatch loop"

# [#1805/SPEC-5]: ADR-006 step 3.6 must say artifacts are restored "from the git state branch".
# Before the doc change: phrase absent → FAILS. After change: PASSES.
assert_contains "[#1805/SPEC-5] ADR-006 step 3.6 documents artifacts restored from the git state branch" \
    "$_adr006" "git state branch"

print_test_section "[#1805/SPEC-6] ADR-050 §6 amended with boundary note distinguishing resume from new runs"

# Extract §6 from ADR-050: content from the "### 6." heading up to (not including) "### 7."
_adr050_s6="$(awk \
    '/^### 6\./{p=1} p && /^### [0-9]+\./ && !/^### 6\./{exit} p{print}' \
    "$ADR_050" 2>/dev/null || true)"

# [#1805/SPEC-6]: §6 boundary note must say the invariant applies to new runs
# and that a resume is governed by ADR-006.
assert_contains "[#1805/SPEC-6] ADR-050 §6 boundary note says invariant applies to new runs" \
    "$_adr050_s6" "new run"

assert_contains "[#1805/SPEC-6] ADR-050 §6 boundary note names ADR-006 as governing resume" \
    "$_adr050_s6" "ADR-006"

# [#1805/SPEC-6]: §6 must say "a resume continues the same run" (not just reference ADR-006).
# Before the doc change: clause absent → FAILS. After change: PASSES.
assert_contains "[#1805/SPEC-6] ADR-050 §6 boundary note says a resume continues the same run" \
    "$_adr050_s6" "continues the same run"

# ── SPEC-12: fresh (non-resume) run dispatches all stages ─────────────────────
print_test_section "[#1805/SPEC-12] fresh non-resume run dispatches all stages (ADR-050 §6 new-run side)"

S12_STATE_DIR="$TEST_TEMP_DIR/s12-state"
S12_EVENTS_DIR="$TEST_TEMP_DIR/s12-events"
S12_EVENTS_JSONL="$S12_EVENTS_DIR/events.jsonl"
S12_STATE_FILE="$S12_STATE_DIR/pipeline-state.json"
mkdir -p "$S12_STATE_DIR/artifacts" "$S12_EVENTS_DIR"

_S12_ID="$(zb_test_issue)"
S12_WORK_REPO="$(setup_git_temp_repo resume-fresh-work)"
# Use a cycle fixture so SPEC-12 and SPEC-13 use the same cyclic pipeline.
# artifact-snapshot-coverage has intake (leaf) + cyc (cycle); that satisfies SPEC-13.
install_template_overlay "$S12_WORK_REPO" artifact-snapshot-coverage
# cycled sub-stage of the cyc cycle declares roles:[builder]
mock_plugin_factory "cycled" "agent" 0 "" "builder" >/dev/null

# Write intake artifact and snapshot to the state branch so the state looks
# exactly like a run interrupted after intake (the state that would trigger
# auto-resume if the --no-resume guard were absent).
printf '{"result_contract":3,"outcome":"pass","reason":"prior-run intake"}' \
    > "$S12_STATE_DIR/artifacts/intake-result.json"

_s12_snap_rc=0
( export ZBUILD_STATE_DIR="$S12_STATE_DIR"
  cd "$S12_WORK_REPO" && _artifact_persist_snapshot "$S12_STATE_DIR" "$_S12_ID" ) \

if [[ "$_s12_snap_rc" -ne 0 ]]; then

        "rc=$_s12_snap_rc; $(cat "$TEST_TEMP_DIR/s12-snap.log" 2>/dev/null | tail -5)"

# Remove the artifact from disk — only the state branch has it now, matching a
# real interrupted run where the workspace was cleaned between pipeline stages.
rm -f "$S12_STATE_DIR/artifacts/intake-result.json"

# State: intake=complete, status=interrupted — exactly what auto-resume would
# act on (skip intake) if the --no-resume flag were NOT passed.
# With --no-resume the runner must start fresh and dispatch all stages.
jq -n \
    --arg run_id "s12-fresh-1805" \
    --arg now "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" \
    --argjson issue "$_S12_ID" \

        schema_version: 1,

        stage_statuses: {intake: "complete"},
        current_iteration: 0,
        self_heal_count: {},

        cost_ledger_pointer: 0,
        claim_lease_id: "",
        plugin_state: {},
        status: "interrupted",

    }' > "$S12_STATE_FILE"

# Run WITH --no-resume: explicitly suppresses auto-resume detection.
# Without --no-resume, the runner would detect status=interrupted, call
# _runner_resume_rehydrate, and skip intake (0 stage.start events for intake).
# With --no-resume, the runner starts fresh: intake dispatches (1 stage.start).
# The assert_eq "1" below distinguishes this flag-guarded fresh run from a run
# that merely happens to have no completed stages in state.
set +e
( cd "$S12_WORK_REPO" && env \
    ZBUILD_PLUGINS_ROOT="$PLUGINS_ROOT" \
    ZBUILD_STATE_DIR="$S12_STATE_DIR" \
    ZBUILD_STATE_FILE="$S12_STATE_FILE" \
    ZBUILD_EVENTS_DIR="$S12_EVENTS_DIR" \
    ZBUILD_EVENTS_JSONL="$S12_EVENTS_JSONL" \
    ZBUILD_EVENT_SCHEMA="$REPO_ROOT/config/event-schema.json" \
    ZBUILD_CONTRACT_VALIDATOR=warn \
    ZBUILD_VISION_GATE=off \
    ZBUILD_CYCLES_ENABLED=1 \
    PATH="$PATH" HOME="$HOME" \
    bash "$RUNNER" --template artifact-snapshot-coverage --no-resume --issue "$_S12_ID" ) \
    >"$TEST_TEMP_DIR/s12-stdout.txt" 2>"$TEST_TEMP_DIR/s12-stderr.txt"
set -e

# [#1805/SPEC-12]: intake must emit stage.start on a fresh run (not skipped by
# rehydration, which only applies on resume). This pins the new-run side of the
# ADR-050 §6 boundary: the prior-work reuse invariant governs new runs; a resume
# (governed by ADR-006) is the only path that may skip complete stages.
_s12_intake_starts=0
if [[ -f "$S12_EVENTS_JSONL" ]]; then
    _s12_intake_starts="$(jq -r 'select(.type=="stage.start") | .data.stage // empty' \
        "$S12_EVENTS_JSONL" 2>/dev/null | grep -c '^intake$' 2>/dev/null || echo 0)"
fi
assert_eq "[#1805/SPEC-12] fresh run dispatches intake (not skipped; ADR-050 §6 new-run side)" \
    "1" "$_s12_intake_starts"

# [#1805/SPEC-12]: the cycled sub-stage must dispatch (cycle executed; no stage skipped).
# Before fix: ZBUILD_CYCLES_ENABLED=0 suppresses the cycle → cycled_starts=0 → assert_gt fails.
# After fix: cycles enabled, cycled sub-stage runs for the 1 configured iteration → PASSES.
_s12_cycled_starts=0
if [[ -f "$S12_EVENTS_JSONL" ]]; then
    _s12_cycled_starts="$(jq -r 'select(.type=="stage.start") | .data.stage // empty' \
        "$S12_EVENTS_JSONL" 2>/dev/null | grep -c '^cycled$' 2>/dev/null || echo 0)"
fi
assert_gt "[#1805/SPEC-12] fresh run dispatches cycled sub-stage (cycle ran; no stage skipped)" \
    "$_s12_cycled_starts" "0"

# [#1805/SPEC-12]: the cycle fixture used for this fresh-run sub-case contains type: cycle,
# establishing that the fixture IS a cyclic pipeline (satisfying the "same cycle fixture" clause).
_s12_fixt_content="$(cat "$REPO_ROOT/tests/fixtures/templates/artifact-snapshot-coverage.yaml")"
assert_contains "[#1805/SPEC-12] cycle fixture used in SPEC-12 fresh-run sub-case has type: cycle" \
    "$_s12_fixt_content" "type: cycle"

# ── SPEC-13: test uses a fixture containing a cyclic stage ────────────────────
print_test_section "resume-rehydrate test uses a fixture containing a cyclic stage"

# : the fixture must contain type: cycle (satisfies "containing a cyclic stage").
# Already read into _s12_fixt_content above from artifact-snapshot-coverage.yaml.
assert_contains "resume-rehydrate fixture contains type: cycle" \
    "$_s12_fixt_content" "type: cycle"

# : a pipeline using that cyclic fixture was actually run in this test.
# _s12_cycled_starts was computed in the SPEC-12 section from the S12 pipeline run.
# Before fix: ZBUILD_CYCLES_ENABLED=0 → cycled never dispatches → 0 → assert_gt fails.
# After fix (cycles enabled, max_iter=1): cycled dispatches → assert_gt passes.
assert_gt "resume-rehydrate: pipeline with cyclic fixture was actually run (cycled dispatched)" \
    "$_s12_cycled_starts" "0"

cleanup_test_env
print_test_results
exit $((FAIL > 0))

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Tests: --from-stage <s> rehydrates completed-stage artifacts before dispatching <s>.
# (issue #1805, ADR-006 §3.5 / _runner_from_stage_preflight)
#
# SPEC-3 [code]: --from-stage <s> rehydrates all stages before <s> via
#   _artifact_persist_restore and _artifact_persist_put_back, places their
#   artifacts in ZBUILD_ARTIFACT_DIR, dispatches <s> as the first stage, and
#   emits no stage.start for any earlier stage.
#
# SPEC-4 [code]: --from-stage <s> when a stage before <s> has no restorable
#   artifact exits 1 before dispatching anything and names the missing stage
#   in stderr.
set -euo pipefail

SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
REPO_ROOT="$(cd "$SCRIPT_DIR/../.." && pwd)"
RUNNER="$REPO_ROOT/core/pipeline/runner.sh"

# shellcheck source=../../scripts/lib/helpers.sh
source "$REPO_ROOT/scripts/lib/helpers.sh"
# shellcheck source=../../scripts/lib/test-helpers.sh
source "$REPO_ROOT/scripts/lib/test-helpers.sh"
# shellcheck source=../../core/state/artifact-persist.sh
source "$REPO_ROOT/core/state/artifact-persist.sh"

print_test_header "from-stage-rehydrate — artifact restore on --from-stage (#1805)"
setup_test_env "from-stage-rehydrate-1805"
export ZBUILD_CONTRACT_VALIDATOR=warn

# ── SPEC-3: --from-stage rehydrates stages before <s> from git state branch ──
print_test_section "[#1805/SPEC-3] --from-stage rehydrates prior-stage artifacts and skips their stage.start"

S3_ID="$(zb_test_issue)"
S3_STATE_DIR="$TEST_TEMP_DIR/s3-state"
S3_EVENTS_DIR="$TEST_TEMP_DIR/s3-events"
S3_EVENTS_JSONL="$S3_EVENTS_DIR/events.jsonl"
S3_STATE_FILE="$S3_STATE_DIR/pipeline-state.json"
mkdir -p "$S3_STATE_DIR/artifacts" "$S3_EVENTS_DIR"

# Create a git repo; _artifact_persist_snapshot writes the state branch here.
S3_WORK_REPO="$(setup_git_temp_repo fs-rehydrate-s3)"
install_template_overlay "$S3_WORK_REPO" runner-state-dir-minimal

# Create mock plugins.
mock_plugin_factory "intake" "agent" 0 >/dev/null
mock_plugin_factory "build"  "agent" 0 >/dev/null
# cycled sub-stage used by the artifact-snapshot-coverage cyclic fixture (SPEC-13 sub-case).
mock_plugin_factory "cycled" "agent" 0 "" "builder" >/dev/null
S3_PLUGINS_ROOT="$TEST_TEMP_DIR/plugins"

# Create the intake primary artifact so the snapshot picks it up.
printf '{"result_contract":3,"outcome":"pass","reason":"prior-run intake"}' \
    > "$S3_STATE_DIR/artifacts/intake-result.json"

# Snapshot onto the state branch in S3_WORK_REPO.
_s3_snap_rc=0
( export ZBUILD_STATE_DIR="$S3_STATE_DIR"
  cd "$S3_WORK_REPO" && _artifact_persist_snapshot "$S3_STATE_DIR" "$S3_ID" ) \
    >"$TEST_TEMP_DIR/s3-snap.log" 2>&1 || _s3_snap_rc=$?
if [[ "$_s3_snap_rc" -ne 0 ]]; then
    assert_fail "[#1805/SPEC-3] setup: snapshot to state branch failed" \
        "rc=$_s3_snap_rc; $(cat "$TEST_TEMP_DIR/s3-snap.log" 2>/dev/null | tail -5)"
else
    assert_pass "[#1805/SPEC-3] setup: state branch populated"
fi

# Remove the artifact from disk; it now lives only on the state branch.
rm -f "$S3_STATE_DIR/artifacts/intake-result.json"

# Write state file: intake=complete, build=pending, status=in_progress.
jq -n \
    --arg run_id "s3-fs-1805" \
    --arg now "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" \
    --argjson issue "$S3_ID" \
    '{
        schema_version: 1,
        run_id: $run_id,
        issue: $issue,
        stage_statuses: {intake: "complete", build: "pending"},
        current_iteration: 0,
        self_heal_count: {},
        scope_manifest_hash: "",
        cost_ledger_pointer: 0,
        claim_lease_id: "",
        plugin_state: {},
        status: "in_progress",
        updated_at: $now
    }' > "$S3_STATE_FILE"

# Run runner with --from-stage build. CWD=S3_WORK_REPO so the state branch
# is reachable. Artifact must be restored before build dispatches.
set +e
( cd "$S3_WORK_REPO" && env \
    ZBUILD_CYCLES_ENABLED=0 \
    ZBUILD_PLUGINS_ROOT="$S3_PLUGINS_ROOT" \
    ZBUILD_STATE_DIR="$S3_STATE_DIR" \
    ZBUILD_STATE_FILE="$S3_STATE_FILE" \
    ZBUILD_EVENTS_DIR="$S3_EVENTS_DIR" \
    ZBUILD_EVENTS_JSONL="$S3_EVENTS_JSONL" \
    ZBUILD_EVENT_SCHEMA="$REPO_ROOT/config/event-schema.json" \
    ZBUILD_CONTRACT_VALIDATOR=warn \
    ZBUILD_VISION_GATE=off \
    PATH="$PATH" HOME="$HOME" \
    bash "$RUNNER" --template runner-state-dir-minimal \
        --resume --from-stage build --issue "$S3_ID" ) \
    >"$TEST_TEMP_DIR/s3-stdout.txt" 2>"$TEST_TEMP_DIR/s3-stderr.txt"
_s3_rc=$?
set -e

# [#1805/SPEC-3]: intake artifact must be in ZBUILD_ARTIFACT_DIR after --from-stage.
# Before the change: no rehydration → file absent → FAILS.
# After the change: _runner_from_stage_preflight restores it → PASSES.
assert_file_exists \
    "[#1805/SPEC-3] intake-result.json rehydrated into ZBUILD_ARTIFACT_DIR via --from-stage" \
    "$S3_STATE_DIR/artifacts/intake-result.json"

# [#1805/SPEC-3]: the restored artifact must carry the payload originally snapshotted to
# the git state branch — this proves _artifact_persist_restore read from git and
# _artifact_persist_put_back placed it in ZBUILD_ARTIFACT_DIR (not re-created fresh by
# the runner through any other mechanism).
# Before the change: no restore → file absent → content="" → FAILS.
# After the change: git state restore → original content present → PASSES.
_s3_restored_content="$(cat "$S3_STATE_DIR/artifacts/intake-result.json" 2>/dev/null || true)"
assert_contains \
    "[#1805/SPEC-3] restored artifact contains original payload (proves _artifact_persist_restore + _artifact_persist_put_back used git state branch)" \
    "$_s3_restored_content" "prior-run intake"

# [#1805/SPEC-3]: intake must emit no stage.start event (it was skipped).
# Before the change: no rehydration means intake might be re-dispatched → stage.start emitted → FAILS.
# After the change: intake is complete and skipped entirely → no stage.start → PASSES.
_s3_intake_starts=0
if [[ -f "$S3_EVENTS_JSONL" ]]; then
    _s3_intake_starts="$(jq -r 'select(.type=="stage.start" and .data.stage=="intake") | .type' \
        "$S3_EVENTS_JSONL" 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d ' ')"
fi
assert_eq "[#1805/SPEC-3] intake emits no stage.start when skipped via --from-stage" \
    "0" "$_s3_intake_starts"

# [#1805/SPEC-3]: build must be the FIRST stage dispatched (stage.start with stage==build).
# Before the change: without rehydration the runner may re-dispatch intake first → FAILS.
# After the change: intake is skipped; build (the --from-stage target) is first → PASSES.
_s3_first_dispatched=""
if [[ -f "$S3_EVENTS_JSONL" ]]; then
    # Use jq -rs to slurp all objects and pick .[0] — avoids | head (SIGPIPE-prone).
    _s3_first_dispatched="$(jq -rs \
        'map(select(.type=="stage.start") | .data.stage // empty) | .[0] // ""' \
        "$S3_EVENTS_JSONL" 2>/dev/null || true)"
fi
assert_eq "[#1805/SPEC-3] build is the first dispatched stage (--from-stage target, intake skipped)" \
    "build" "$_s3_first_dispatched"

# ── SPEC-4: missing artifact with --from-stage exits 1 and names missing stage ─
print_test_section "[#1805/SPEC-4] --from-stage with no restorable artifact exits 1 naming missing stage"

S4_ID="$(zb_test_issue)"
S4_STATE_DIR="$TEST_TEMP_DIR/s4-state"
S4_EVENTS_DIR="$TEST_TEMP_DIR/s4-events"
S4_EVENTS_JSONL="$S4_EVENTS_DIR/events.jsonl"
S4_STATE_FILE="$S4_STATE_DIR/pipeline-state.json"
mkdir -p "$S4_STATE_DIR/artifacts" "$S4_EVENTS_DIR"

# Fresh repo with no state branch for S4_ID — no artifact anywhere.
S4_WORK_REPO="$(setup_git_temp_repo fs-rehydrate-s4)"
install_template_overlay "$S4_WORK_REPO" runner-state-dir-minimal

# State: intake=complete, build=pending, NO artifact on disk, NO state branch.
jq -n \
    --arg run_id "s4-fs-1805" \
    --arg now "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" \
    --argjson issue "$S4_ID" \
    '{
        schema_version: 1,
        run_id: $run_id,
        issue: $issue,
        stage_statuses: {intake: "complete", build: "pending"},
        current_iteration: 0,
        self_heal_count: {},
        scope_manifest_hash: "",
        cost_ledger_pointer: 0,
        claim_lease_id: "",
        plugin_state: {},
        status: "in_progress",
        updated_at: $now
    }' > "$S4_STATE_FILE"

set +e
( cd "$S4_WORK_REPO" && env \
    ZBUILD_CYCLES_ENABLED=0 \
    ZBUILD_PLUGINS_ROOT="$S3_PLUGINS_ROOT" \
    ZBUILD_STATE_DIR="$S4_STATE_DIR" \
    ZBUILD_STATE_FILE="$S4_STATE_FILE" \
    ZBUILD_EVENTS_DIR="$S4_EVENTS_DIR" \
    ZBUILD_EVENTS_JSONL="$S4_EVENTS_JSONL" \
    ZBUILD_EVENT_SCHEMA="$REPO_ROOT/config/event-schema.json" \
    ZBUILD_CONTRACT_VALIDATOR=warn \
    ZBUILD_VISION_GATE=off \
    PATH="$PATH" HOME="$HOME" \
    bash "$RUNNER" --template runner-state-dir-minimal \
        --resume --from-stage build --issue "$S4_ID" ) \
    >"$TEST_TEMP_DIR/s4-stdout.txt" 2>"$TEST_TEMP_DIR/s4-stderr.txt"
_s4_rc=$?
set -e

# [#1805/SPEC-4]: runner must exit 1 when prior stage has no restorable artifact.
# Before the change: runner has no preflight check → continues → exits 0 → FAILS.
# After the change: _runner_from_stage_preflight exits 1 → PASSES.
assert_eq "[#1805/SPEC-4] --from-stage exits 1 when prior stage has no restorable artifact" \
    "1" "$_s4_rc"

# [#1805/SPEC-4]: stderr must name the missing stage ("intake").
_s4_stderr="$(cat "$TEST_TEMP_DIR/s4-stderr.txt" 2>/dev/null || true)"
assert_contains \
    "[#1805/SPEC-4] stderr names the missing stage (intake)" \
    "$_s4_stderr" "intake"

# [#1805/SPEC-4]: no stage.start must be emitted before the exit.
_s4_any_starts=0
if [[ -f "$S4_EVENTS_JSONL" ]]; then
    _s4_any_starts="$(jq -r 'select(.type=="stage.start") | .type' \
        "$S4_EVENTS_JSONL" 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d ' ')"
fi
assert_eq "[#1805/SPEC-4] no stage.start emitted before exit 1" \
    "0" "$_s4_any_starts"

# ── SPEC-13: test uses a fixture containing a cyclic stage ────────────────────
print_test_section "from-stage-rehydrate test uses a fixture containing a cyclic stage"

# Run a fresh pipeline against the cyclic fixture (artifact-snapshot-coverage) to
# demonstrate that this test file exercises a pipeline containing a cyclic stage.
_S13_FS_ID="$(zb_test_issue)"
_S13_FS_WORK="$(setup_git_temp_repo fs-s13-cycle-check)"
install_template_overlay "$_S13_FS_WORK" artifact-snapshot-coverage

_S13_FS_STATE_DIR="$TEST_TEMP_DIR/s13fs-state"
_S13_FS_EVENTS_DIR="$TEST_TEMP_DIR/s13fs-events"
_S13_FS_EVENTS_JSONL="$_S13_FS_EVENTS_DIR/events.jsonl"
_S13_FS_STATE_FILE="$_S13_FS_STATE_DIR/pipeline-state.json"
mkdir -p "$_S13_FS_STATE_DIR/artifacts" "$_S13_FS_EVENTS_DIR"

jq -n \
    --arg run_id "s13fs-fresh-1805" \
    --arg now "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" \
    --argjson issue "$_S13_FS_ID" \
    '{
        schema_version: 1, run_id: $run_id, issue: $issue,
        stage_statuses: {}, current_iteration: 0, self_heal_count: {},
        scope_manifest_hash: "", cost_ledger_pointer: 0, claim_lease_id: "",
        plugin_state: {}, status: "in_progress", updated_at: $now
    }' > "$_S13_FS_STATE_FILE"

set +e
( cd "$_S13_FS_WORK" && env \
    ZBUILD_PLUGINS_ROOT="$S3_PLUGINS_ROOT" \
    ZBUILD_STATE_DIR="$_S13_FS_STATE_DIR" \
    ZBUILD_STATE_FILE="$_S13_FS_STATE_FILE" \
    ZBUILD_EVENTS_DIR="$_S13_FS_EVENTS_DIR" \
    ZBUILD_EVENTS_JSONL="$_S13_FS_EVENTS_JSONL" \
    ZBUILD_EVENT_SCHEMA="$REPO_ROOT/config/event-schema.json" \
    ZBUILD_CONTRACT_VALIDATOR=warn \
    ZBUILD_VISION_GATE=off \
    PATH="$PATH" HOME="$HOME" \
    bash "$RUNNER" --template artifact-snapshot-coverage --issue "$_S13_FS_ID" ) \
    >"$TEST_TEMP_DIR/s13fs-stdout.txt" 2>"$TEST_TEMP_DIR/s13fs-stderr.txt"
set -e

# : the fixture is cyclic (type: cycle present).
_s13_fs_content="$(cat "$REPO_ROOT/tests/fixtures/templates/artifact-snapshot-coverage.yaml")"
assert_contains "from-stage-rehydrate test uses a cyclic fixture (type: cycle)" \
    "$_s13_fs_content" "type: cycle"

# : confirm the cyclic pipeline ran (intake dispatched in the fresh run).
_s13_fs_intake_starts="$(jq -r 'select(.type=="stage.start") | .data.stage // empty' \
    "$_S13_FS_EVENTS_JSONL" 2>/dev/null | grep -c '^intake$' || echo 0)"
assert_eq "cyclic fixture pipeline ran in from-stage-rehydrate test (intake dispatched)" \
    "1" "$_s13_fs_intake_starts"

cleanup_test_env
print_test_results
exit $((FAIL > 0))

mkdir -p "$ZBUILD_EVENTS_DIR" "$ZBUILD_STATE_DIR"

# shellcheck source=../../core/pipeline/cycle-orchestrator.sh
source "$REPO_ROOT/core/pipeline/cycle-orchestrator.sh"
# shellcheck source=../../core/pipeline/template.sh
source "$REPO_ROOT/core/pipeline/template.sh"
# shellcheck source=../lib/cycle-report-stub.sh
source "$REPO_ROOT/tests/lib/cycle-report-stub.sh"

STATE_FILE="$ZBUILD_STATE_DIR/pipeline-state.json"

# ── SPEC-7: cycle starts from persisted current_iter on resume ─────────────────
print_test_section "[#1805/SPEC-7] cycle orchestrator resumes from current_iter (not 1)"

# Seed minimal state file required by _cycle_state_init.
: > "$ZBUILD_EVENTS_JSONL"
jq -n '{schema_version:1, stage_statuses:{}, updated_at:"seed"}' > "$STATE_FILE"

# Use zb_engine_loop_state to write one completed iteration (current_iter=1)
# into the state file. This simulates: iter-1 of the cycle has run and
# completed; the run was then interrupted before iter-2 dispatched.
# After the change the orchestrator will read current_iter=1 and start from
# iter-2 (current_iter + 1). Before the change it starts from iter=1.
zb_engine_loop_state "$STATE_FILE" "build-test" 1 5 "in_progress"

# Load the cycle template.
load_template "$FIXT/cycle-converges-iter2.yaml"

# Mock cycle_dispatch_stage: record the first iter dispatched, always pass.
# We record across all stages because the very first dispatch call reveals
# which iter the orchestrator started from.
_SPEC7_FIRST_ITER=-1
cycle_dispatch_stage() {
    local stage="$1" iter="$2"
    if [[ "$_SPEC7_FIRST_ITER" -eq -1 ]]; then
        _SPEC7_FIRST_ITER="$iter"
    fi
    _CYCLE_DISPATCH_VERDICT="pass"
    _CYCLE_DISPATCH_STATUS="complete"
    return 0
}

# The report stub makes the test member report zero test failures (pass).
zb_stub_reports_tests test

# Run the cycle orchestrator against the seeded state.
# Before this change: loop starts at iter=1 → first dispatch is iter=1.
# After this change: loop reads current_iter=1 → starts at iter=2 → first is 2.
set +e
cycle_orchestrator_run "build-test" "$ZBUILD_STATE_DIR" "$STATE_FILE"
_s7_rc=$?
set -e

# [#1805/SPEC-7]: first dispatched iter must be 2, not 1.
# Before the change: _SPEC7_FIRST_ITER=1 → assert 2==1 → FAILS.
# After the change:  _SPEC7_FIRST_ITER=2 → assert 2==2 → PASSES.
assert_eq \
    "[#1805/SPEC-7] first dispatched iter is 2 (resumed from current_iter=1, not restarted from 1)" \
    "2" "$_SPEC7_FIRST_ITER"

# ── SPEC-13: test uses a fixture containing a cyclic stage ────────────────────
print_test_section "resume-loop-state test uses a fixture containing a cyclic stage"

# cycle-converges-iter2.yaml is loaded above via load_template and driven through
# cycle_orchestrator_run. Assert it contains type: cycle to formally pin the fixture
# contains a cyclic stage (as this test's SPEC-13 contract requires).
_s13_loop_fixt_content="$(cat "$FIXT/cycle-converges-iter2.yaml")"
assert_contains "cycle fixture used by resume-loop-state test has type: cycle" \
    "$_s13_loop_fixt_content" "type: cycle"

# Also assert the pipeline was actually run: cycle_dispatch_stage was invoked
# during cycle_orchestrator_run above, setting _SPEC7_FIRST_ITER from its
# initial -1.  A value > -1 proves the cyclic stage was dispatched.
assert_gt \
    "resume-loop-state ran the cyclic pipeline (cycle_dispatch_stage was invoked)" \
    "$_SPEC7_FIRST_ITER" "-1"

cleanup_test_env
print_test_results
exit $((FAIL > 0))

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Tests: all three resume entry paths invoke _runner_resume_rehydrate before
# the dispatch loop. (issue #1805, ADR-006 §3.5)
#
# SPEC-9 [code]: All three resume entry paths (--resume flag to runner.sh,
#   auto-resume on detecting status=interrupted, zbuild pipeline resume
#   --run-id) invoke _runner_resume_rehydrate before the dispatch loop.
#   Its test must FAIL on the code as it was before this change.
#
# Three sub-tests, each with a separate work repo, state dir, and events dir:
#   Path 1 — bash runner.sh --resume
#   Path 2 — bash runner.sh (no --resume; state status=interrupted → auto_resume)
#   Path 3 — bash zbuild pipeline resume --run-id

# ZBUILD_ARTIFACT_DIR after the runner call (artifact restored from state branch).
# Before this change: no rehydration → artifact absent → FAILS.
# After this change: _runner_resume_rehydrate restores it → PASSES.
set -euo pipefail

SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
REPO_ROOT="$(cd "$SCRIPT_DIR/../.." && pwd)"
RUNNER="$REPO_ROOT/core/pipeline/runner.sh"
ZBUILD_CLI="$REPO_ROOT/scripts/zbuild"

# shellcheck source=../../scripts/lib/helpers.sh
source "$REPO_ROOT/scripts/lib/helpers.sh"
# shellcheck source=../../scripts/lib/test-helpers.sh
source "$REPO_ROOT/scripts/lib/test-helpers.sh"
# shellcheck source=../../core/state/artifact-persist.sh
source "$REPO_ROOT/core/state/artifact-persist.sh"

print_test_header "resume-entry-points — all resume paths rehydrate artifacts (#1805)"
setup_test_env "resume-entry-points-1805"
export ZBUILD_CONTRACT_VALIDATOR=warn

# Common mock plugins for all three paths.
mock_plugin_factory "intake" "agent" 0 >/dev/null
mock_plugin_factory "build"  "agent" 0 >/dev/null
# cycled sub-stage used by the artifact-snapshot-coverage cyclic fixture (SPEC-13 sub-case).
mock_plugin_factory "cycled" "agent" 0 "" "builder" >/dev/null
PLUGINS_ROOT="$TEST_TEMP_DIR/plugins"

# ── Shared helper: set up a work repo with a state branch for one path ──────────
# Usage: _setup_path_state <label> <issue_id> → sets:
#   P_WORK_REPO, P_STATE_DIR, P_STATE_FILE, P_EVENTS_DIR, P_EVENTS_JSONL
_setup_path_state() {
    local label="$1" issue_id="$2"

    P_WORK_REPO="$(setup_git_temp_repo "ep-${label}")"
    install_template_overlay "$P_WORK_REPO" runner-state-dir-minimal

    P_STATE_DIR="$TEST_TEMP_DIR/${label}-state"
    P_EVENTS_DIR="$TEST_TEMP_DIR/${label}-events"
    P_STATE_FILE="$P_STATE_DIR/pipeline-state.json"
    P_EVENTS_JSONL="$P_EVENTS_DIR/events.jsonl"

        assert_fail "setup-${label}: snapshot to state branch failed" \
            "rc=$_snap_rc; $(cat "$TEST_TEMP_DIR/${label}-snap.log" 2>/dev/null | tail -5)"
    fi

    # Remove artifact from disk; it now lives only on the state branch.
    rm -f "$P_STATE_DIR/artifacts/intake-result.json"
}

# ── PATH 1: --resume flag to runner.sh ────────────────────────────────────────
print_test_section "[#1805/SPEC-9] path 1: bash runner.sh --resume restores artifacts"

P1_ID="$(zb_test_issue)"
_setup_path_state "p1" "$P1_ID"
P1_WORK_REPO="$P_WORK_REPO"
P1_STATE_DIR="$P_STATE_DIR"

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# core/pipeline/cycle-orchestrator.sh — ADR-021 outer-cycle orchestrator (F1)
#
# F1 = foundational framework + flag-gated stub. NO concrete cycle wired in
# config/templates/standard.yaml (F2/#511 does that). Runner only enters the
# cycle branch when ZBUILD_CYCLES_ENABLED=1 AND a `cycles:` overlay is parsed.
#
# Public surface:
#   cycle_orchestrator_run <cycle_id> <state_dir> <state_file>
#     rc: 0=converged, 1=max_iterations, 2=plateau, 3=divergence,
#         130=aborted, 4=config_invalid (template error)
#     Sets globals:
#       _CYCLE_LAST_TERMINATED_REASON  string enum
#       _CYCLE_LAST_ITERATIONS         int
#       _CYCLE_LAST_HISTORY_FILE       absolute path
#       _CYCLE_LAST_MEMBER_HALT        "<word>: <reason>" when a member's result
#                                      halted the run (ADR-068 §3), else empty
#
# Internal helpers (prefix `_cycle_`):
#   _cycle_load_template / _cycle_iter_dispatch / _cycle_install_traps /
#   _cycle_clear_traps   / _cycle_on_signal     / _cycle_record_iter_outcome /
#   _cycle_check_until   / _cycle_check_max_iterations /
#   _cycle_detect_plateau / _cycle_detect_divergence /
#   _cycle_apply_feedback / _cycle_handle_terminal
#
# Sourced library: do not add `set -euo pipefail` here.

[[ -n "${_ZBUILD_CYCLE_ORCH_LOADED:-}" ]] && return 0
_ZBUILD_CYCLE_ORCH_LOADED=1

_CYCLE_ORCH_DIR="$(cd "${BASH_SOURCE[0]%/*}" 2>/dev/null || true; pwd)"
_CYCLE_ORCH_ROOT="$(cd "$_CYCLE_ORCH_DIR/../.." && pwd)"

# shellcheck source=../../scripts/lib/helpers.sh
source "$_CYCLE_ORCH_ROOT/scripts/lib/helpers.sh"
# ADR-025 (Wave 15-B #684) abort-propagation contract helpers.
# shellcheck source=../../scripts/lib/abort-propagation.sh
source "$_CYCLE_ORCH_ROOT/scripts/lib/abort-propagation.sh"
# shellcheck source=../state/atomic.sh
source "$_CYCLE_ORCH_ROOT/core/state/atomic.sh"
# shellcheck source=../state/resume.sh
source "$_CYCLE_ORCH_ROOT/core/state/resume.sh"
# shellcheck source=../event-bus/event-bus.sh
source "$_CYCLE_ORCH_ROOT/core/event-bus/event-bus.sh"
# shellcheck source=./template.sh
source "$_CYCLE_ORCH_ROOT/core/pipeline/template.sh"
# shellcheck source=../output/event-banners.sh
# #526: operator-visible WARN banner for HIGH-severity cycle events.
source "$_CYCLE_ORCH_ROOT/core/output/event-banners.sh"
# #833: cycle INPUT/OUTPUT boundary banners go through the stage-io chokepoint

# ADR-025 (Wave 15-E #685): defensive sentinel cleanup at resume entry.
        # The normal SIGINT path's EXIT trap already disarms the sentinel
        # in `_runner_abort_trap`, but a hard kill (-9), host crash, or any
        # path that skipped the EXIT trap can leave a stale .abort.signal.
        # Without this disarm the first `_zbuild_check_abort` pre-flight in
        # the dispatch loop would observe the stale sentinel and abort the
        # resumed run immediately. Resume must always start from a clean
        # signal channel.
        _zbuild_disarm_abort_sentinel
        # ADR-006 §3.6 (#1805): restore completed-stage artifacts from the git
        # state branch before the dispatch loop, so complete stages have their
        # primary artifacts available. A still-absent artifact causes exit 1 at
        # the dispatch loop's stale-artifact check.
        _runner_resume_rehydrate "$_runner_issue" "$state_dir"
        eb_emit_event "pipeline.resume" "run_id=$_runner_run_id" "issue=$_runner_issue"
        info "Pipeline resuming — run_id=$_runner_run_id issue=${issue:-} goal=${goal:-} template=$template"
        if [[ -n "$from_stage" ]]; then
            warn "Skipping ahead to stage '$from_stage' as requested (--from-stage)"
            eb_emit_event "pipeline.skip_to_stage" "stage=$from_stage" "run_id=$_runner_run_id"
        fi
    else
        # #1791: the engine sha rides on pipeline.start and the banner so an
        # operator can answer "which engine graded this?" without archaeology.
        local _eng_sha="${_RUNNER_ENGINE_SHA:-$(_runner_engine_sha)}"
        local _eng_br="${_RUNNER_ENGINE_BRANCH:-$(_runner_engine_branch)}"

STATE_FILE="$ZBUILD_STATE_DIR/pipeline-state.json"
INNER_HISTORY="$ZBUILD_STATE_DIR/cycle-build_test_cycle-history.jsonl"
: > "$ZBUILD_EVENTS_JSONL"
rm -f "$STATE_FILE" "${STATE_FILE}.bak" "${STATE_FILE}.lock"
jq -n '{schema_version:1, stage_statuses:{}, updated_at:"seed"}' > "$STATE_FILE"

TPL="$TEST_TEMP_DIR/two-level.yaml"
cat > "$TPL" <<'EOF'
id: two_level_reset
name: Inner Resets per Outer Iter Test
defaults:
  strategy: fanout

flow:
  - build_review_cycle

build_review_cycle:
  type: cycle
  flow:
    - build_test_cycle
    - review
  exit_when:
    stage: review
    field: verdict
    op: eq
    value: approve
  max_iterations: 2
  on_max: continue

build_test_cycle:
  type: cycle
  flow:
    - build
    - test
  exit_when:
    stage: test
    field: verdict
    op: eq
    value: approve
  max_iterations: 2
  on_max: continue

build:
  roles: [builder]

test:
  roles: [tester]

review:
  roles: [reviewer]
EOF

# Inner never converges but its TESTS PASS: build/test emit verdict=pass while the
# inner exit_when requires test.verdict==approve (a value `test` never emits), so
# the inner exhausts max_iterations UNCONVERGED-BUT-PASSING → #1208 outcome
# unconverged (soft, non-halting) — NOT outcome failed (a failing-test inner
# would hard-halt the outer, #1208). Both return rc=1 since #1850 (ADR-054 §4;
# they were rc=2 / rc=8) — the outcome word is what differs.
# This keeps the inner non-fatal so the outer re-dispatches it across outer iters,
# exercising the iter+history reset (the actual regression under test) without the
# #944 anti-pattern of advisory-review-rescuing failing tests.
# Outer's review flips: outer iter 1 → request_changes (forces outer iter 2),
# outer iter 2 → approve (forces convergence).
_OUTER_ITER_OBSERVED=0
cycle_dispatch_stage() {
    local stage="$1"
    case "$stage" in
        build|test)
            _CYCLE_DISPATCH_VERDICT="pass"
            _CYCLE_DISPATCH_VERDICT_RAW="pass"
            ;;
        review)
            _OUTER_ITER_OBSERVED=$(( _OUTER_ITER_OBSERVED + 1 ))
            if [[ $_OUTER_ITER_OBSERVED -eq 1 ]]; then
                _CYCLE_DISPATCH_VERDICT="fail"
                _CYCLE_DISPATCH_VERDICT_RAW="request_changes"
            else
                _CYCLE_DISPATCH_VERDICT="pass"
                _CYCLE_DISPATCH_VERDICT_RAW="approve"
            fi
            ;;
    esac
    _CYCLE_DISPATCH_STATUS="complete"
    return 0
}

# shellcheck source=../../core/pipeline/template.sh
source "$REPO_ROOT/core/pipeline/template.sh"
_TPL_STAGES=(); _TPL_CYCLES=()
load_template "$TPL" || assert_fail "template load"

set +e; cycle_orchestrator_run "build_review_cycle" "$ZBUILD_STATE_DIR" "$STATE_FILE"; rc=$?; set -e

print_test_section "outer iter 2 entered and converges"

assert_eq "T1: outer cycle converges rc=0 (review approve on iter 2)" "0" "$rc"
assert_eq "T2: review was called twice (one per outer iter)" "2" "$_OUTER_ITER_OBSERVED"

print_test_section "inner cycle resets across outer iters"

# T3: inner cycle.start fires exactly twice (once per outer iter).
inner_start_count=$(jq -c 'select(.type=="cycle.start" and .data.cycle_id=="build_test_cycle")' "$ZBUILD_EVENTS_JSONL" 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d ' ')
assert_eq "T3: inner cycle.start emitted twice (one per outer iter)" "2" "$inner_start_count"

# T4: BOTH inner cycle.start events report iter=1 (fresh, not continuing).
both_at_iter1=$(jq -r 'select(.type=="cycle.start" and .data.cycle_id=="build_test_cycle") | .data.iter' "$ZBUILD_EVENTS_JSONL" 2>/dev/null | sort -u)
assert_eq "T4: both inner cycle.start at iter=1 (RESET, not 4)" "1" "$both_at_iter1"

# T5: inner cycle.complete fires twice (one per outer iter), both max_iterations.
inner_complete_count=$(jq -c 'select(.type=="cycle.complete" and .data.cycle_id=="build_test_cycle")' "$ZBUILD_EVENTS_JSONL" 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d ' ')
assert_eq "T5: inner cycle.complete emitted twice" "2" "$inner_complete_count"

inner_reasons=$(jq -r 'select(.type=="cycle.complete" and .data.cycle_id=="build_test_cycle") | .data.reason' "$ZBUILD_EVENTS_JSONL" 2>/dev/null | sort -u)
assert_eq "T6: both inner runs terminated reason=max_iterations" "max_iterations" "$inner_reasons"

# T7: inner cycle.iteration.complete events — should be 4 total (2 iters × 2 outer iters).
inner_iter_complete_count=$(jq -c 'select(.type=="cycle.iteration.complete" and .data.cycle_id=="build_test_cycle")' "$ZBUILD_EVENTS_JSONL" 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d ' ')
assert_eq "T7: inner cycle.iteration.complete emitted 4 times (2 iter × 2 outer iter)" "4" "$inner_iter_complete_count"

# T8: each inner pass's iteration.complete events go iter=1, iter=2.
inner_iters_observed=$(jq -r 'select(.type=="cycle.iteration.complete" and .data.cycle_id=="build_test_cycle") | .data.iter' "$ZBUILD_EVENTS_JSONL" 2>/dev/null | sort | uniq -c | sed 's/^[[:space:]]*//')
assert_eq "T8: inner iteration counts: 2 of iter=1, 2 of iter=2 (proves reset)" "$(printf '2 1\n2 2')" "$inner_iters_observed"

print_test_section "inner history file truncated on outer iter 2"

# T9: inner history file ends with the LAST outer iter's iter rows only.
# After outer iter 2 completes, inner history should contain exactly 2 rows
# (from outer iter 2's inner run), NOT 4 rows accumulated across outer iters.
history_row_count=$(wc -l "$INNER_HISTORY" 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $1}' || echo 0)
assert_eq "T9: inner history file contains 2 rows (truncated on outer iter 2 entry)" "2" "$history_row_count"

# T10: the rows in the inner history are iter 1 and iter 2 (NOT iter 3, 4).
history_iters=$( { jq -r '.n' "$INNER_HISTORY" 2>/dev/null || true; } | sort -u | tr '\n' ',' | sed 's/,$//')
assert_eq "T10: inner history rows have iter=1 and iter=2 only (reset on outer iter 2)" "1,2" "$history_iters"

print_test_section "outer cycle emits expected events"

outer_iter_complete=$(jq -c 'select(.type=="cycle.iteration.complete" and .data.cycle_id=="build_review_cycle")' "$ZBUILD_EVENTS_JSONL" 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d ' ')
assert_eq "T11: outer cycle.iteration.complete emitted twice" "2" "$outer_iter_complete"

outer_complete=$(jq -r 'select(.type=="cycle.complete" and .data.cycle_id=="build_review_cycle") | .data.reason' "$ZBUILD_EVENTS_JSONL" 2>/dev/null | head -1)
assert_eq "T12: outer cycle.complete reason=converged" "converged" "$outer_complete"

print_test_section "Wave 19-D-1 member.dispatch events span both outer iters"

# Outer iter 1: dispatches build_test_cycle (kind=cycle) + review (kind=leaf). 2 start events.
# Outer iter 2: same. 2 more start events. Total: 4 dispatch.start at the outer cycle.
outer_dispatch_starts=$(jq -c 'select(.type=="cycle.member.dispatch.start" and .data.cycle_id=="build_review_cycle")' "$ZBUILD_EVENTS_JSONL" 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d ' ')
assert_eq "T13: 4 cycle.member.dispatch.start at outer (2 members × 2 iters)" "4" "$outer_dispatch_starts"

# Each outer iter dispatches inner_cycle then review. So we should see this
# exact ordering at the outer level: build_test_cycle, review, build_test_cycle, review.
outer_dispatch_members=$(jq -r 'select(.type=="cycle.member.dispatch.start" and .data.cycle_id=="build_review_cycle") | .data.member' "$ZBUILD_EVENTS_JSONL" 2>/dev/null | tr '\n' ',' | sed 's/,$//')
assert_eq "T14: outer member dispatch order is build_test_cycle,review,build_test_cycle,review" "build_test_cycle,review,build_test_cycle,review" "$outer_dispatch_members"

# Inner cycle's dispatch.complete on iter 1 (after inner returns rc=1) records verdict=fail.
inner_member_complete_verdicts=$(jq -r 'select(.type=="cycle.member.dispatch.complete" and .data.cycle_id=="build_review_cycle" and .data.member=="build_test_cycle") | .data.verdict' "$ZBUILD_EVENTS_JSONL" 2>/dev/null | sort -u)
assert_eq "T15: inner_cycle dispatch.complete verdict=fail (max_iter mapping)" "fail" "$inner_member_complete_verdicts"

print_test_results
cleanup_test_env
exit $((FAIL > 0))

# ─── _artifact_persist_restore <issue> <restored_dir> [repo_root] ───────────
# Extract the tip of the state branch into <restored_dir> (created if absent).
# Prefers a local refs/heads/<branch>; falls back to refs/remotes/origin/<branch>
# when only the fetched remote ref is present (CI). No-op (rc 0, empty dir) when
# no state branch exists. Never touches the working tree.
_artifact_persist_restore() {
    _artifact_persist_reset_status
    local issue="${1:-0}" restored_dir="$2" repo_root="${3:-$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)}"
    # Resolve the SHARED git dir (see _artifact_persist_git_dir). Two reasons:
    #   1. refs must be read from the shared store, not a per-worktree view;
    #   2. the old guard tested `-d "$repo_root/.git"`, which is FALSE in a linked
    #      worktree because .git is a file there — restore would silently no-op and
    #      prior artifacts would never come back, with no error to notice.
    local _gd=""
    [[ -n "$repo_root" ]] && _artifact_persist_git_dir_v _gd "$repo_root"
    [[ -z "$restored_dir" ]] && { _ARTIFACT_PERSIST_LAST_STATUS="failed"
        _ARTIFACT_PERSIST_LAST_REASON="no restored_dir given"; return 2; }
    if [[ -z "$repo_root" || ! -d "$_gd" ]]; then
        _ARTIFACT_PERSIST_LAST_STATUS="failed"
        _ARTIFACT_PERSIST_LAST_REASON="unresolvable repo: repo_root=[${repo_root:-<empty>}] git_dir=[${_gd:-<empty>}] cwd=[$PWD]"
        return 1
    fi

    local branch; _artifact_persist_branch_v branch "$issue"
    local ref=""
    if GIT_DIR="$_gd" git rev-parse -q --verify "refs/heads/$branch" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        ref="refs/heads/$branch"
        _ARTIFACT_PERSIST_LAST_SOURCE="local"
    elif GIT_DIR="$_gd" git rev-parse -q --verify "refs/remotes/origin/$branch" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        ref="refs/remotes/origin/$branch"
        _ARTIFACT_PERSIST_LAST_SOURCE="remote"
    else
        # A first-ever run for this issue. Genuinely nothing to restore — the one
        # early return here that is NOT a failure.
        _ARTIFACT_PERSIST_LAST_STATUS="empty"
        _ARTIFACT_PERSIST_LAST_REASON="no $branch locally or on origin (first run)"
        return 0
    fi

    if ! mkdir -p "$restored_dir"; then
        _ARTIFACT_PERSIST_LAST_STATUS="failed"
        _ARTIFACT_PERSIST_LAST_REASON="mkdir -p $restored_dir failed"
        return 1
    fi
    # git archive streams the tree; tar unpacks it, no checkout / index change.
    # #1878: PIPESTATUS, not the pipeline rc — a failing `git archive` piped into
    # a happy `tar` yields rc=0, so a broken restore reported success.
    # PR #1880 review: guarded (see the _ct_err note above).
    local _ar_err; _ar_err="$(mktemp -u "$(zbuild_engine_tmpdir)/zbuild-restore-err.XXXXXX" 2>/dev/null)" || _ar_err="/dev/null"
    [[ -n "$_ar_err" ]] || _ar_err="/dev/null"
    GIT_DIR="$_gd" git archive "$ref" 2>"$_ar_err" | tar -x -C "$restored_dir" 2>>"$_ar_err"
    local _st=("${PIPESTATUS[@]}")
    if [[ "${_st[0]}" -ne 0 || "${_st[1]}" -ne 0 ]]; then
        local err; err="$(cat "$_ar_err" 2>/dev/null | tr '\n' ' ')"
        rm -f "$_ar_err"
        _ARTIFACT_PERSIST_LAST_STATUS="failed"
        _ARTIFACT_PERSIST_LAST_REASON="restore of $ref failed (archive rc=${_st[0]} tar rc=${_st[1]}): ${err:-<no stderr>}"
        return 1
    fi
    rm -f "$_ar_err"
    # PR #1880 review: "restored", NOT "saved". The same channel carries both
    # operations' outcomes, so reusing "saved" would let a caller checking
    # `== "saved"` to confirm a SNAPSHOT be satisfied by a restore that happened
    # to run first — the restore runs once at startup, before any snapshot.
    _ARTIFACT_PERSIST_LAST_STATUS="restored"
    _ARTIFACT_PERSIST_LAST_REASON="restored from $ref"
    return 0
}

if [[ "$existing_status" == "aborted" ]] && ! $force; then
            error "Pipeline status is 'aborted'; use --force to resume anyway"
            return 1
        fi
        if [[ "$existing_status" == "complete" ]]; then
            warn "Pipeline status is 'complete'; starting fresh"
            resume_mode=false
        else
            # Restore run_id and issue from existing state
            _runner_run_id="$(get_state_field "$state_file" '.run_id' "$(date +%Y%m%d%H%M%S)-$$")"
            _runner_issue="$(get_state_field "$state_file" '.issue' '0')"
        fi
    elif ! $no_resume && [[ -f "$state_file" ]]; then
        # Auto-resume policy
        local recommendation
        recommendation="$(get_resume_recommendation "$state_file")"
        case "$recommendation" in
            auto_resume)
                info "Auto-resuming previous run (use --no-resume to force fresh start)"
                resume_mode=true
                _runner_run_id="$(get_state_field "$state_file" '.run_id' "$(date +%Y%m%d%H%M%S)-$$")"
                _runner_issue="$(get_state_field "$state_file" '.issue' '0')"
                ;;
            manual_resume_only)
                info "Previous run requires explicit --resume (or --force for aborted)"
                resume_mode=false
                ;;
            fresh_start|*)
                resume_mode=false
                ;;
        esac
    fi

    if ! $resume_mode; then
        # Sanitize ZBUILD_RUN_ID: strip characters unsafe in filenames (/, .., spaces, etc.)
        # to prevent path traversal when run_id is used in report-${run_id}.md filenames
        # AND in the per-run state dir below (#887). Generated BEFORE the re-root.
        local _raw_run_id="${ZBUILD_RUN_ID:-$(date +%Y%m%d%H%M%S)-$$}"
        _runner_run_id="${_raw_run_id//[^a-zA-Z0-9_.-]/}"
        # Fall back to generated ID if sanitization emptied the value
        [[ -z "$_runner_run_id" ]] && _runner_run_id="$(date +%Y%m%d%H%M%S)-$$"
        # #141: assigned HERE, not after init_state. The layout switch below
        # reads it to derive the run key, and it used to be set ~35 lines later
        # — so on a fresh run the switch always saw an EMPTY issue, produced an
        # empty key, and took the no-identity fallback. Every run since the
        # switch landed kept the flat shape and nothing said so
        # (`~/.zbuild/repos/` was never created). Resume paths above set it from
        # state and are unaffected.
        _runner_issue="${issue:-0}"
        # #887: default state → isolate under runs/<run_id>/ so concurrent runs
        # never share artifacts. run_id is path-sanitized above. Done before
        # init_state so the per-run state file is the one created.
        if $_state_is_default; then
            # #141 (ADR-059 §1): nest the run under its ISSUE (or goal), so
            # everything for an issue lives in one place:
            #   ~/.zbuild/repos/<owner>/<repo>/issues/<N>/runs/<run_id>/
            # A run with no identity keeps the flat shape — there is nothing to
            # nest it under. Resolved through core/state/layout.sh so the
            # reclaimers read the same definition the writer uses.
            local _rk=""
            if declare -F zbuild_run_key >/dev/null 2>&1; then
                _rk="$(zbuild_run_key "$_runner_issue" "${goal:-}" 2>/dev/null || true)"
            fi
            # An EMPTY key is a legitimate answer only for a run with neither an
            # issue nor a goal. If this run HAS an identity and the key came back
            # empty, the nesting silently degrades to the flat shape — which is
            # indistinguishable from the legitimate case and is exactly how the
            # ordering defect above survived undetected. Say so.
            if [[ -z "$_rk" ]] \
               && { [[ -n "$_runner_issue" && "$_runner_issue" != "0" ]] || [[ -n "${goal:-}" ]]; }; then
                warn "run key is empty despite issue='${_runner_issue}' goal='${goal:-}' — state will use the pre-#141 flat layout"
            fi

            else
                state_dir="${ZBUILD_STATE_ROOT:-$HOME/.zbuild/state}/runs/$_runner_run_id"
            fi
            mkdir -p "$state_dir"
            state_file="$state_dir/pipeline-state.json"

mock_plugin_factory() {

    local dir="$TEST_TEMP_DIR/plugins/$kind/$id"

    local fn; fn="${id//-/_}_run"
    cat > "$dir/manifest.yaml" <<EOF
id: $id
name: Test $id
kind: $kind
version: $version
hooks:
  run: $fn
requires:
  core:
    - redaction
EOF
    [[ -n "$platform" ]] && printf 'platform: %s\n' "$platform" >> "$dir/manifest.yaml"
    printf 'provides:\n  result_contract: 3\n' >> "$dir/manifest.yaml"
    [[ -n "$role" ]] && printf '  role: %s\n' "$role" >> "$dir/manifest.yaml"
    cat >> "$dir/manifest.yaml" <<EOF
outputs:
  - id: ${id//-/_}_result
    path: \${artifact_dir}/${id}-result.json
    type: ${id}-result.json@1
    format: json
    required: true
    primary: true
EOF
    local _outcome=pass _srl
    [[ "$exit_code" -ne 0 ]] && _outcome=broken
    _srl="$(cd "${BASH_SOURCE[0]%/*}" 2>/dev/null || true; pwd)/stage-result.sh"
    cat > "$dir/plugin.sh" <<EOF
${fn}() {
    local _art; _art="\${ZBUILD_ARTIFACT_DIR:-\$(dirname "\$2")/artifacts}"
    mkdir -p "\$_art"
    source "$_srl"
    stage_result_write "\$_art/${id}-result.json" "$_outcome" "mock $id"
    return $exit_code
}
EOF
    printf '%s\n' "$dir"
}

# ── zb_engine_loop_state ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Writes one loop's record into a pipeline-state.json with the ENGINE's own
# writers (_cycle_state_init / _cycle_state_write_iter_atomic,
# core/pipeline/cycle-orchestrator.sh): <rounds> rounds, then <final status>.
# #1799: a hand-written `cycle_iterations` holds whatever its author assumed —

# scripts/lib/lint-test-engine-state.sh refuses a hand-written one.
#
# Usage: zb_engine_loop_state <state_file> <loop id> <rounds> <limit> <final status>
zb_engine_loop_state() {
    local sf="$1" id="$2" rounds="$3" limit="$4" final="$5" root
    root="$(cd "${BASH_SOURCE[0]%/*}" 2>/dev/null || true; cd "../.." && pwd)"

}
